title: Brand · Rebolt

elements.text: The name of the company is Rebolt. Always capitalize the "R" when referring to the company or product. Do not include ".ai" or "AI" in the name. "Rebolt.ai" or "Rebolt AI" must not
When referring to Rebolt as a company, on social media, or where a “fancy” design is required, it is acceptable to use this stylized icon with an appropriate corner radius.
The primary color of the Rebolt brand is #006AFE. This color is used for the Rebolt logo, icon, and wordmark.
